Evidence:
[1] In the spring of 2016, the trio parted ways with the Big Machine Label Group and later signed to Interscope Records.
[2] In 2014, the band signed with Republic Nashville of Big Machine Label Group and released its first single "Smoke", which set a record for the highest debut by a new act when it opened at number 28 on the Country Aircheck radio chart.
[3] Nolan Lambroza, better known as Sir Nolan, is a songwriter and record producer based in Los Angeles.
[4] They signed to Republic Nashville in August 2009 and released their self-titled debut album on October 12, 2010.

Notes:
[bridge] Sir Nolan has worked with The Band Perry, a sibling trio.
